description: This file defines a custom exception class SelfServiceRegistrationNotFoundException that extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException, used to indicate that a self-service registration was not found based on request ID and authentication token.

classes.name: SelfServiceRegistrationNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception signaling that a self-service registration with specified request ID and authentication token was not found.

methods.name: SelfServiceRegistrationNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a specific error message including request ID and authentication token.
